title: Hello, Quantum C!
description:
Welcome to **Quantum C**.

In this course, you will be making a custom quantum computer simulator, called `TechQ`. This course will teach you eveything about QuantumC, but for now:

### Assignment:
Change the text in the `std::qout` statement to print to console "Starting VM". Ignore the << '\n' bit
hint: Just change the string between `std::qout << ` and ` << '\n'` so it matches exactly.
